title: Traceable acceptance chain
statement: The fictional ESS example retains linked requirement, integration-test, and acceptance evidence for the covered enrollment behavior
limitation: Applies only to the synthetic covered behavior and does not establish all ESS workflows

title: Propagation evidence remains incomplete
statement: The fictional RIS example documents the intended downstream reporting handoff and a contract check, but the packet does not contain retained evidence of an end-to-end propagation check
limitation: Missing retained evidence is not proof that no manual or undocumented check occurred

title: Representative propagation evidence only
statement: The fictional IAM example has direct evidence for one dependent application, while the packet does not establish equivalent propagation evidence for the other listed consumers
limitation: Do not extrapolate one representative consumer to all dependents
